correctness.rationale: The sampled product defect is an explicit lattice-sum error. Polynomial-exponential variation bounds give entries O((nk)^-1(1+log(n/k))^d), hence summable column norms O(k^-3/2) and a trace-norm convergent nuclear decomposition. Triangular diagonal entries then give the stated zeta traces.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. The 2026 source proves a general Hilbert--Schmidt defect and explicitly leaves Schatten refinements open. Targeted exact and synonymous searches found no trace-class semigroup refinement or zeta-trace formula; older Cesaro/Hausdorff and lattice-correction literature remains a residual prior-art risk.

value.rationale: The result upgrades the canonical Cesaro-generated Mellin semigroup from Hilbert--Schmidt to trace-class multiplicativity and computes an exact zeta-valued trace anomaly for every pure Cesaro power.
